changelog: **Lead (v60.02):** The home one-line sentence may judge: the owner decision of 2026-11-12 (AGENTS.md "Judgement allowed") permits an assessment and bans only an order to the reader, but the sentence gate rejected any 매수/매도 outside a short list, so "주식 매수가 부담스러운 구간입니다" was dropped as an instruction. A named assessment exemption (매수 부담, 매수하기 좋은·유리한·불리한 구간/국면, 추격 매수의 비용, 매도 압력·우위, 현금 우위) is set aside before the instruction test; imperatives (사세요, 매수하세요, 비중을 줄이세요), recommendations and a bare action word ("지금은 매수", "매도할 때") are still rejected.
note: v60.02: home sentence assessment exemption (owner 2026-11-12 Judgement allowed)
